title: Hardly: почти не, а не усердно
description: Hardly: почти не, а не усердно: применяем правило в новых ситуациях, разбираем словарь, диалог и авторский текст без аудирования.
notes: Work hard — усердно работать; hardly work — почти не работать.
Hardly обычно уже несёт отрицательный смысл: I can hardly hear, без дополнительного not.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: The recording was so faint that I could ___ hear the speaker.
exercises.explanation: Hardly выражает почти полное отсутствие слышимости.

exercises.prompt: Вставь слово из пары: hard / hardly.

public_payload.sentence: She works ___ and checks every entry carefully.

exercises.editorial_answer: She works hard and checks every entry carefully.
exercises.explanation: Усердную работу описывает hard, а hardly означало бы почти не работает.

exercises.prompt: Собери предложение: «Я едва мог расслышать объявление.»
exercises.editorial_answer: I could hardly hear the announcement.
exercises.explanation: Hardly характеризует слышимость, не силу старания слушателя.

exercises.prompt: Исправь ошибку в указанной конструкции, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

public_payload.sentence: She hardly never misses a deadline.

accepted: She hardly ever misses a deadline.

exercises.reference_answer: She hardly ever misses a deadline.
exercises.incorrect_answer: She hardly never misses a deadline.
exercises.editorial_answer: She hardly ever misses a deadline.
exercises.explanation: Для значения «почти никогда» используется hardly ever, без второго отрицания never.

public_payload.passage: A reviewer wrote that she could hardly hear the spoken introduction in a demonstration recording. The producer initially read this as praise for how hard she had listened. In fact, she was reporting a problem with audibility, not describing effort. She had listened carefully, but several words remained indistinct even in a quiet room. The producer raised the recording level and sent a new version. In her second response, the reviewer distinguished the clearer sound from the quality of the script, which she had not yet assessed. The exchange illustrates why a small difference between hard and hardly can substantially alter the practical action a message calls for.

options.label: She had refused to listen carefully.
The script had already been judged excellent.

exercises.explanation: Сообщение касалось слышимости; оценка сценария ещё не проводилась.

exercises.prompt: Соедини слова с переводом в контексте урока.
exercises.editorial_answer: hardly — почти не; diligently — усердно; audible — слышимый; faint — слабый по интенсивности
exercises.explanation: В этих контекстах: hardly — почти не; diligently — усердно; audible — слышимый; faint — слабый по интенсивности.

lines.text: Did “I could hardly hear” describe diligent listening?

options.label: It proved that every word was clear.
It described limited audibility; effort needs separate evidence.
